questions.question: How many companies operates airlines in each airport?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.id ,  count(*) FROM operate_company AS T1 JOIN flight AS t2 ON T1.id  =  T2.company_id JOIN airport AS T3 ON T2.airport_id  =  T3.id GROUP BY T3.id

questions.question: What is the id, name and IATA code of the airport that had most number of flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name ,  T1.IATA FROM airport AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.airport_id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find number of products which Sony does not make.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT name) FROM products WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT T1.name FROM products AS T1 JOIN manufacturers AS T2 ON T1.Manufacturer  =  T2.code WHERE T2.name  =  'Sony')

questions.question: How many products are not made by Sony?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT name) FROM products WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT T1.name FROM products AS T1 JOIN manufacturers AS T2 ON T1.Manufacturer  =  T2.code WHERE T2.name  =  'Sony')

questions.question: Return the names of artists and the themes of their exhibitions that had a ticket price higher than average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.theme ,  T2.name FROM exhibition AS T1 JOIN artist AS T2 ON T1.artist_id  =  T2.artist_id WHERE T1.ticket_price  >  (SELECT avg(ticket_price) FROM exhibition)

questions.question: Count the number of exhibitions that have had an attendnance of over 100 or a ticket prices under 10.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM exhibition_record AS T1 JOIN exhibition AS T2 ON T1.exhibition_id  =  T2.exhibition_id WHERE T1.attendance  >  100 OR T2.ticket_price  <  10

questions.question: What are the names of photos taken with the lens brand 'Sigma' or 'Olympus'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM camera_lens AS T1 JOIN photos AS T2 ON T2.camera_lens_id  =  T1.id WHERE T1.brand  =  'Sigma' OR T1.brand  =  'Olympus'

questions.question: Find the ids and names of members who are under age 30 or with black membership card.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  member_id FROM member WHERE Membership_card  =  'Black' OR age  <  30

questions.question: What are the names of the tourist attractions that have parking or shopping as their feature details?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'park' UNION SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'shopping'

questions.question: What are the id and the amount of refund of the booking that incurred the most times of payments?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.booking_id ,  T1.amount_of_refund FROM Bookings AS T1 JOIN Payments AS T2 ON T1.booking_id  =  T2.booking_id GROUP BY T1.booking_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
